scope: Standing Aga Khan Palace exterior in Pune, from its mapped forecourt steps and fountain through the arcaded palace ranges to the rear wings. Museum interiors, detached buildings and memorials are outside this model’s scope.

review.notes: The existing Qualla images were screened first. The confirmed public-domain photograph shows the nearby ashes memorial. The historical palace photograph has unresolved first publication and US status. The reconstruction uses the mapped standing footprint, original terrain and written architectural surveys.
